decisions: Use the latest confirmed Binance page update timestamp, 15:23 UTC October 31, as the conservative anchor for the 24-hour SAFU deployment window; the page was originally published at 14:24 UTC and does not explicitly state which timestamp starts the clock.
Do not conclude that SAFU deployment failed before November 1 15:23 UTC; the official window remains open through that conservative deadline.

Record 15,000.00147092 BTC as a cross-explorer displayed balance, corroborated by BitInfoCharts, Tokenview and SoChain, while preserving the 27-versus-28 transaction-count discrepancy and absent current block-height timestamp.
Treat the SAFU acquisition program as aimed at remaining less-liquid tokens outside the ten fully backed assets; XRP is in the ten-asset set, so no incremental XRP purchase or demand is inferred.

Keep SAFU, Futures Insurance Fund and corporate treasury as distinct funding sources. The Futures Insurance Fund is not user assets and Binance says only excess above required coverage was reallocated.
Do not admit SAFU wallet balances or insurance-fund pools as directional XRP features until time-aligned historical observations, source refresh timestamps and coverage denominators are available.
required_verification: Obtain raw transaction IDs and UTXO balance from an independent current explorer/API.
Compare full November 3 PoR asset-level XRP reserves and liabilities.
Capture official Futures Insurance Fund refresh at 00:00 UTC and compare pool-level balances.
